_note: Replace every value marked REPLACE before go-live. Run `node build.mjs` after any change.

location._help: Shown in the footer and given to Google. Add streetAddress/postalCode only if you want the office address public.

cms._help: Blog editor at /admin. repo = the GitHub repository this site deploys from (owner/name).

blog._help: Categories shown in the blog editor and as filters on /blog/. Rename or add freely; a category only gets its own page once it has a published post. postsPerPage = cards shown before 'Show more posts'.

look._help: preset: calm | balanced | vivid. Any value below overrides the preset. glow/grain/grid/spotlight/shimmer: 0 to 1. motion: calm | normal | off. buttons: soft | bright. defaultTheme: system | dark | light (used until the visitor picks one).

cityLine: Based in Indore, India · working with brands across India and worldwide
